question_summary: Deteriorated existing structure was discovered behind the finish wall at Placement Zone 2, differing from the assumed condition; contractor asks whether a local layout shift is acceptable or if design review is needed before proceeding.
proposed_solution: Shift the layout locally at the affected area and hold everything else per the original plan.
routing_rationale: As a field condition conflict without broader schedule impact, it is routed to the Structural Engineer, the design professional of record for the deteriorated structural condition.
